--allow-low-disk.help: Continue installation even if free disk space is below 15GB (not recommended).

--allow-low-memory.help: Allow CI preflight to continue when available RAM is critically low (below 1.0 GB). Place this before CI passthrough args.

--bh-admin-password.help: BloodHound CE admin password to set during Docker installation.

--bloodhound-admin-password.help: Desired BloodHound CE admin password used during install.

--bloodhound-stack-mode.help: BloodHound runtime mode. `managed` (default) starts ADscan's isolated compose stack.

--client-logo.help: Client logo (PNG/SVG/JPG) placed beside the ADscan mark on the report cover; persisted and reused on later runs.

--content-type.help: Force Content-Type (auto-detected from extension if omitted)

--da.help: Show sessions from computer perspective (Domain Admin view)

--dc-ip.help: PDC/DC IP (required for auth mode; optional for unauth to skip host discovery)

--debug.help: Enable debug output (launcher + forwarded to container subcommands where applicable).

--demo.help: Boot the workbench on top of the deterministic demo workspace.

--direct-only.help: Show only direct group memberships (skip recursive expansion)

--display-name.help: Client-facing name shown on the report cover (e.g. the web workspace name).

--fast.help: Compress phase pacing to ~12s (CI / marketing capture).

--file.help: Path to ZIP file to upload

--fix.help: Attempt automatic repairs for detected issues (best effort).

--generate-report.help: Generate report after successful scan with flags captured (requires Report License)

--help.help: show this help message and exit

--image.help: Override the ADscan Docker image (defaults to env ADSCAN_DOCKER_IMAGE or channel).

--islocal.help: 'true' for a local dump, 'false' for remote.

--json.help: Emit one structured JSON object to stdout (machine-readable) instead of the human matrix.

--keep-workspace.help: Keep the workspace after scan completion (do not delete auto-created workspace)

--list.help: List the verbs available to `execute` and exit.

--no-browser.help: Do not open the BloodHound browser automatically.

--no-history.help: Do not snapshot the layer into the workspace history (PRO).

--no-html.help: Skip the interactive HTML bundle, JSON only (PRO).

--no-navigator.help: Skip the MITRE ATT&CK Navigator extras (JSON layer + interactive HTML + diff). Default: included in every kit.

--no-open.help: Do not prompt to open the PDF after rendering.

--no-open-browser.help: Do not open the BloodHound CE login page automatically during installation.

--no-render.help: Smoke / dry-run only — verify template + content, skip PDF render.

--no-telemetry.help: Disable anonymous usage telemetry for this run (sensitive engagements). Sets ADSCAN_TELEMETRY=0 inside the scan container.

--no-update-check.help: Skip the launcher/runtime version probe and update prompts (no PyPI / Docker Hub call). Usable as a prefix before any command, including container passthroughs. Mid-engagement / airgapped / version-pinned use only.

--no-wait.help: Return immediately after upload is accepted

--offline.help: Offline mode: disable every external lookup (weakpass / no-external guard) for air-gapped or sovereign engagements. Sets ADSCAN_OFFLINE=1 inside the scan container.

--only.help: Install only specific components (for QA testing). Use: --only bloodhound rusthound pyenv

--ou-dn.help: Distinguished Name of an OU to list its users (CE only)

--output.help: Output mode. 'human' (default) renders Rich panels/tables; 'json' emits one JSON envelope per operation to stdout; 'quiet' suppresses everything except the final JSON envelope.

--password-never-expires.help: Show only users with password never expires

--password-not-required.help: Show only users with password not required

--pull-timeout.help: Docker pull timeout in seconds (default: 3600). Set to 0 to disable the timeout.

--report-theme.help: Report theme: premium_dark or corporate_light (default: none).

--rtp-wait-seconds.help: Seconds to wait for RTP to scan after upload

--scan-config.help: Path to a YAML/JSON scan-configuration file that pre-configures the scan (disable optional phases, set the trust-enumeration and attack-path policies). Absent = today's interactive defaults. The file is bind-mounted read-only into the scan container. Place it before the auth/unauth positional.

--scan-mode.help: rtp=real-time protection (catches ML/cloud), mpcmdrun=static scan (faster, misses cloud)

--scripted.help: Force the scripted demo even if a .cast recording exists.

--seed.help: Random seed for jitter (default: 42 — keeps pacing reproducible).

--show-structural.help: Show the STRUCTURAL band in the Tactical Findings panel (INFO-severity edges that are part of the expected AD hierarchy — Domain Admins, Enterprise Admins, DCs, SYSTEM). Hidden by default to keep the panel focused on choke points.

--smb-username.help: Local-admin SMB user for upload (bypasses MSSQL upload when Defender intercepts PowerShell writes). Example: eddard.stark

--tag.help: Optional tag/label to include with upload (reserved)

--target-domain.help: Domain for filtering the target node; use 'all' to disable filtering

--tui.help: Launch the Textual-based TUI instead of the default prompt_toolkit shell.

--verbose.help: Enable verbose output (launcher + forwarded to container subcommands where applicable).

--version.help: Show launcher version and Docker image configuration.

--web.help: Open the generated interactive HTML in the default browser (PRO).

args.help: Arguments passed to the container after `ci`

auth.help: Authenticate to BloodHound CE and save API token

cheatsheet.help: Render the Quick-Start Cheat Sheet PDF (operator companion).

ci.help: [EXPERIMENTAL] Run ADscan in autonomous mode (skips all prompts, applies defaults)

custom.help: Execute a custom Cypher query in BloodHound

demo.help: Run a deterministic 60-second demo scan against a baked-in fake AD.

doctor.help: Fast one-shot health check (DNS, connectivity, auth, posture).

doctor_args.help: Arguments forwarded to the container health check.

execute.help: Run a single REPL command non-interactively (scripting / smoke-test).

execute_args.help: Verb and arguments forwarded to the container (see `adscan execute --list`).

group.help: List group memberships for a user

list-catalog.help: List variants in a catalog YAML

mitre-navigator.help: Export a MITRE ATT&CK Navigator layer (JSON + interactive HTML).

report.help: Generate a report from an existing workspace without re-scanning.

rest.help: Arguments forwarded verbatim to the verb (session flags may also appear here).

set.help: Saves the connection configuration for Neo4j (legacy)

update.help: Update ADscan launcher and Docker image.

welcome.help: Show the editorial welcome screen (default when no command is given).
